scope: function-field d=1, current sector p congruent 5 mod 6
priority_rule: Attempt application-side Airy-to-hook transport before the integral Tate-diagonal fallback.

gates.title: Literal object dictionary
gates.pass: Every source summand, projector, degree, shift, twist, Frobenius convention and boundary term has a literal target or correction object.
gates.pivot: An essential source or target object cannot be defined independently of first-trace numerics.

gates.title: Invariant compatibility
gates.pass: Rank, weight, determinant, inertia, conductor, field of definition, support and boundary traces are compatible after explicit corrections.

gates.title: All-Frobenius trace identity
gates.pass: An exact identity for every Frobenius power n, with literal Tate, Artin-Schreier and punctual correction objects.
gates.pivot: A proved all-power trace mismatch after correction.

gates.title: Semisimple transport
gates.pass: A theorem-level semisimple isomorphism or virtual equality with hypotheses explicit.
gates.pivot: Failure of the exact all-power identity or field-of-definition hypotheses.

gates.title: Derived/application transport
gates.pass: An exact triangle, correspondence or filtered comparison preserving the detector residual; the cone contains only audited correction terms.
gates.pivot: A proved extension or parity obstruction.

gates.title: Half-sector crown assembly
gates.pass: Complete p congruent 5 mod 6 irreducibility proof with q=2, q=infinity, twist, Tate, Artin-Schreier, punctual and small-prime terms explicit.
gates.claim_boundary: No full d=1 or integer Fortune claim.

gates.title: Integral model and comparison
gates.pass: A perfect Cp-equivariant integral Airy complex and Weil-compatible comparison realizing both the generic Adams trace and modular Smith/Tate contraction.

gates.title: Bounded-cone attempt
gates.pass: Uniformly bounded generic comparison cone after the explicit Tate correction.
gates.pivot: A theorem proving growing cone for every admissible construction in the frozen class.

gates.title: Linear-cone cancellation
gates.pass: Absolute Frobenius trace O(p^((p+1)/2)) after exact trivial and Artin-Schreier subtraction.

gates.title: Analytic propagation
gates.pass: Absolute-constant Airy estimate and insertion into the exact application ledger.

gates.title: Full d=1 sector ledger
gates.pass: All other prime sectors and small primes are separately certified before any full d=1 claim.

closed_routes: raw prime sweeps without a preregistered identity
TFP3 transfer without an explicit theorem-level bridge
